_comment: Single source of truth for UI framework detection. Add new frameworks here — ui-check.ps1 and ui-monitor agent read this file at runtime. No other files need editing.

frameworks.name: Angular
checks: [object Object] rendered in template (missing pipe or async)
NG0 errors in console (e.g. NullInjectorError, ExpressionChangedAfterItHasBeenChecked)
router-outlet renders blank (missing route or lazy-load failure)
Unresolved async pipe (| async) showing null or undefined

frameworks.name: SvelteKit
checks: Svelte 5 rune errors ($state/$derived used outside component)
TipTap editor toolbar items missing or unresponsive
Drizzle ORM values rendering as undefined in UI
SvelteKit load() error causing blank page (check +error.svelte)

frameworks.name: Vite / Vue / Lit
checks: HMR WebSocket disconnect (vite WS errors in console)
Missing module 404 (bare import not resolved)
Vue reactivity warning (non-reactive object mutated)

frameworks.name: Next.js / React
checks: Hydration mismatch (server/client HTML differs)
React key warning in list renders
Missing NEXT_PUBLIC_ env variable (undefined in client bundle)
Image domain not configured in next.config.js (broken <Image>)

frameworks.name: Astro
checks: Island hydration error (client:load directive failing)
Missing props on hydrated component
404 on static asset from public/

frameworks.name: Streamlit
checks: Python traceback shown in error pane
Empty DataFrame renders (no data loaded)
Broken WebSocket on /_stcore/stream (check network tab)
st.cache_data stale (outdated data shown after code change)

frameworks.name: Flask / Jinja2
checks: Unrendered {{ variable }} literals visible on page
500 Internal Server Error page (Werkzeug debugger)
Blank chart canvas (JS chart library failed to init)
Missing static asset (url_for() path wrong)

frameworks.name: Django
checks: CSRF token missing on POST forms
Django 500 / 404 debug page
Template tag rendering as literal text
Static files 404 (STATICFILES_DIRS misconfigured)

frameworks.name: FastAPI
checks: OpenAPI docs page blank (schema generation error)
CORS error on API calls from frontend
422 Unprocessable Entity on valid requests (schema mismatch)

frameworks.name: Dash
checks: Blank Graph component (Plotly failed to render — check console)
dash.exceptions callback error in browser console
/_dash-layout or /_dash-dependencies fetch failed (network tab)
Missing dcc / dbc component styles (CDN blocked)

frameworks.name: Gradio
checks: Component not rendering (Gradio version mismatch)
Model output missing (inference error — check server logs)
WebSocket disconnect on /queue/join
File upload failing (tmp dir permissions)

frameworks.name: Reflex
checks: Blank page with spinner stuck (state hydration failed on /__event WebSocket)
rx. component not found error in console
Missing reflex.js bundle (404 in network tab)
State update not reflected in UI (WebSocket disconnect)

frameworks.name: Panel
checks: Bokeh widget not rendering (BokehJS load failed)
WebSocket disconnect on /ws endpoint
Missing pn- prefixed component (Panel version mismatch)
Layout overflow (HoloViews plot overflowing container)

frameworks.name: Solara
checks: Widget not rendering (ipyvuetify component missing)
Kernel connection failed (check Jupyter kernel status)
Missing ipywidgets output (display() not called)
Reactivity not triggering (use_state hook misuse)

frameworks.name: Marimo
checks: Cell execution error shown inline
DAG cycle detected (circular cell dependencies)
Missing output render (cell not marked as output)
Reactive variable not propagating to dependent cells

frameworks.name: Storybook
checks: Story not rendering (component import error)
Missing controls panel (args not defined in story)
Broken addon panel (addon not registered in .storybook/main.js)
Canvas blank (decorator throwing error)

frameworks.name: Generic HTTP
checks: 404s for linked CSS/JS/image assets
Any JS error in console
Broken layout (missing stylesheet)
Mixed content warnings (HTTP assets on HTTPS page)
